{{Quote|For Dac!|Shonmai as she sacrifices her life to stop the [[One Sith|Sith]]|<ref name="Legacy 33" />}}
'''Shonmai''' was a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] and a [[Mon Calamari Rangers|Mon Calamari Ranger]] in [[137 ABY]]. She survived the initial stages of the [[Genocide on Dac]] and fought for her people's safety alongside her fellow Rangers. Eventually, Shonmai sacrificed her life to bring down [[Vul Isen]]'s [[Sea Leviathan]], a creature which would have greatly expedited the extinction of the Mon Calamari race.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Sithspit! Shonmai, what ''is'' that?''"<br />"''Not native to Dac!|Adriphar and Shonmai, upon first seeing the Sea Leviathan|<ref name="Legacy 33" />}}
The [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] Shonmai and her fellow [[Mon Calamari Rangers]] [[Adriphar]] were scouting the area near the [[Devil's Crevasse]] when they spotted something abnormal on their scopes. Recognizing it to be too big to be an [[Acklay-class mobile fortress|Acklay]] and not a native creature of [[Dac/Legends|Dac]], the two Mon Cals approached the massive creature on a reconnaissance run. As they scouted the creature, they felt certain that [[Imperial Knight|Master]] [[Treis Sinde]] and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Tanquar]] should be informed of this new devilry. When they got closer, they were noticed by the [[Aquatic Terrain Armored Transport]] riding herd beside the beast. Shonmai told Adriphar to get out of there, but his [[Krakana underwater fighter|Krakana]] was shot down by the vessel. He crashed into the monster and warned Shonmai to get back to the [[Ranger Grotto]], before his life-force was sucked out by the beast.<ref name="Legacy 33" />

Shocked by Adriphar's sudden death, Shonmai rushed back to the Grotto and told the other Rangers of the encounter. Tanquar began preparing for an attack against the beast in order to save the Mon Calamari refugees being attacked. Sinde, however, tried to dissuade the Rangers from performing a suicidal attack on the creature, which he recognized as a [[One Sith|Sith]]-created [[Sea Leviathan]], specifically designed to kill the Mon Calamari. As the Rangers were unwilling to let their people die as they waited in safety, Sinde changed his mind and came up with a new plan: the Rangers would attack and destroy the AT-AT swimmer, he would use [[Animal bond|the Force]] to command a legion of [[Devilsquid]] to leave the crevasse and attack the Leviathan, and two extra Rangers would then use the emptied crevasse to shelter the fleeing Mon Calamari.<ref name="Legacy 33" />

===Devil's Crevasse===
{{Quote|Shonmai, I told you to sit this one out!''"<br />"''Just like Master Sinde told all of us to sit it out. I'm ignoring your order for the same reason. These are my people.|Tanquar and Shonmai, beginning the attack on the Sea Leviathan|<ref name="Legacy 33" />}}
[[File:Shonmai.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Shonmai in her Krakana]]
As the rebel forces began their approach on Devil's Crevasse, Shonmai ignored Tanquar's order to sit out the battle, as she felt a need to fight for her people. When they reached the Leviathan and the AT-AT swimmer, Sinde swam into the Crevasse to commune with the Devilsquid while the rangers arced around the beast and attacked the swimmer, trying to save the fleeing refugees. However, the Krakanas' plasma weapons could not pierce the swimmer's powerful shield until the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Azard]], believing the Leviathan to be endangered by the Devilsquid, commanded the [[Vehicle Command Crewer|pilot]] to lower the shields surrounding the hangar and release the [[Shark underwater fighter|Shark]] fighters. Shonmai recognized the chance to stop the swimmer.<ref name="Legacy 33" />

===Sacrifice and Death===
{{Quote|Captain Tanquar! The swimmer's opening a hatch&hellip; The shields around it are down!''"<br />"''We can't do anything about it, Shonmai! We can't get through this blaster fire!''"<br />"''I can. ''For Dac!|Shonmai and Tanquar, seizing on the opportunity to destroy the AT-AT swimmer|<ref name="Legacy 33" />}}
Shonmai informed Captain Tanquar of the lowered shields, but the blaster fire coming from the swimmer made it impossible for the other Krakana to swoop in and assist in destroying it. Seizing the opportunity and using her close position to the hangar, Shonmai powered up her Krakana's drives to full and rammed directly into the swimmer's hangar, destroying it instantly at the cost of her own life. Her sacrifice enabled the Krakana to destroy the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Imperial]] Sharks and the Devilsquid pulled the Sea Leviathan into the Crevasse to devour it. Although the Sith ringleaders had escaped the wreckage of the swimmer, the Mon Calamari had defeated the Leviathan and would continue to fight.<ref name="Legacy 33" />

==Behind the scenes==
Shonmai appeared in the [[2009]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] [[Legacy (2006) 33|''Legacy'' (2006) 33]], the second issue of ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]''{{'s}} [[Star Wars: Legacy: Fight Another Day|''Fight Another Day'']] story arc. Her name was spelled "Shonm''o''i" twice in Adriphar's dialogue, but it was otherwise spelled with an "a."<ref name="Legacy 33" />
